lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I am gonna eat this thing first.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I am gonna be the new alpha.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: No, there is no, there is no need for a new alpha.
lines.translationTr: Hayır, hiçbir gerek yok, yeni bir alfa gerek yok.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: You are not even a beta.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: No, you are not the alpha!

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: What did that thing just do?

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I am sorry, where were we?

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I am gonna devour this thing.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I am gonna bite her arm clean off.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: You didn't bite her arm clean off.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I did the same thing you did.
lines.translationTr: Ben de senin yaptığın şeyi yaptım.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Agree, I agree, I agree, I agree.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: This tiny thing is now a wolf, everybody!
lines.translationTr: Bu minik şey şimdi bir kurt, herkes!

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Back of the pack, we are keeping it.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: The delivery is now complete, now I just need to find a way out of here.
lines.translationTr: Teslimat tamamlandı, şimdi buradan çıkış yolu bulmam lazım.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Wait, you are not gonna deliver her to her actual parents?
lines.translationTr: Bekle, gerçek ebeveynlerine teslim etmeyecek misin?

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Baby doesn't know the difference, because babies are dumb.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Babies have a higher level than intelligence that we will ever understand.
lines.translationTr: Bebeklerin anlayamayacağımız kadar yüksek bir zeka seviyesi var.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: You sound like a baby that learned how to talk.
lines.translationTr: Sanki konuşmayı yeni öğrenen bir bebek gibi konuşuyorsun.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I am a baby that learned how to talk.
lines.translationTr: Ben konuşmayı öğrenen bir bebek oldum.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Hey, I want a teacher to walk around in circles.
lines.translationTr: Bak şimdi, bir öğretmen dönüp durmalı istiyorum.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: That is my favorite thing to teach.
lines.translationTr: Öğretmeyi sevdiğim en güzel şey bu.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: You are going to scare it.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I apologize for what I am about to do.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: All right, I have an idea.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Imagine how much harder she could hit me if you cut us down.
lines.translationTr: Eğer bizi kesersen, ne kadar daha sert vurabileceğini hayal et.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I could really wail on this guy.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: I mean, you don't have to go that hard.
lines.translationTr: Yani, bu kadar zorlanmana gerek yok.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Oh, I am still mad at you.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: Oh, this tiny, twig-be in this.
lines.translationTr: Aman, bu minik, dal-be-dal var bu içinde.

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.translationTr: Sadece en büyük tavsiye! (Literally: En büyük dal budama tavsiyesi!)

lines.speaker: Speaker
lines.text: How are you guys with people what they want?
